card.name: Unit after 'per' in dose rates
card.fires_on: The word that completes a 'per ___' rate in dosing text, such as 'dose' in 'mg/kg per dose', 'nostril' in 'sprays per nostril', or 'day' in 'units/kg/day'.

modes.label: Per dose
modes.description: The word dose or its ending after 'per' or a slash in a weight-based rate.
modes.example: Children (2 years of age and older): 20 mg/kg per<< dose>> orally 4 times daily (8

modes.label: Per nostril
modes.description: The ending of nostril after 'per' in nasal spray directions.
modes.example: Pediatric patients 5 to 11 years of age: 1 spray per nostr<<il>> twice daily ( 2.1 )

modes.label: Per day
modes.description: The unit of time closing a per-weight rate.
modes.example: 250,000 units/kg<</day>> divided in equal doses every 4 hours

card.plain: It fires on the last word of a 'per dose', 'per nostril' or 'per day' rate in dosing directions.
